name: 1320 Fabrication
old_description: Welcome to our fabrication shop- where precision meets craftsmanship. From complete race car chassis service and modifications to custom roll cages and fabricated components, we do it all. Stop by our shop for everything your race car needs to win.
about:
1320 Fabrication operates a race-car fabrication shop in Glen Burnie, Maryland. The company has not publicly disclosed its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The shop specializes in TIG welding of Chromoly, stainless steel, aluminum, and titanium, and provides complete chassis work for hot rods, imports, bracket cars, dragsters, and Pro Mods. Services include roll bars and cages built to NHRA 25.1–25.5 specifications, mini-tubs, stainless-steel headers and exhaust, custom rear housings, suspension setup, fuel cells, turbo manifolds, intercoolers, carbon-fiber components, Lexan windows, chassis scaling, race jacks, and JR dragster fabrication. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers are primarily drag-racing teams and builders across classes such as Super Street, bracket racing, and Jr. Dragster. The shop is a title sponsor of the PDRA Super Street Series and a multi-year sponsor of the Maryland International Raceway ET Series, indicating a focus on organized drag-racing competition.

The company describes its approach as "where precision meets craftsmanship" and aims to supply everything a race car needs to win. No explicit founding mission or differentiator statement beyond that tagline is provided.
